facts.title: cold noodles with miso, lime and ginger
ingredients: A mixture of raw vegetables of your choice (such as carrots, cucumbers, radishes or daikon; see Note for more suggestions)
2 to 3 tablespoons miso (red is recommend; white would be just fine)
1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne, or to taste
2 tablespoons lime juice (from about 1 lime), plus lime wedges for serving
facts.yield_text: Serves 4 as a light meal or appetizer; for bigger appetites, you might want to double this
facts.author: Deb Perelman
